name: Análisis de Marcadores Discursivos
description: Analiza the usage patrones of marcadores discursivos (connectives, transitions) to differentiate generado por IA from escrito por humanos text.
useCase: Detección de texto IA mediante uso excesivo o insuficiente de conectivos discursivos cohesivos
mechanism: Identifica and quantifies marcadores discursivos (e.g., 'however', 'therefore', 'furthermore', 'in addition') and their positional distribución dentro de texts. generado por IA text typically exhibits a narrower set of marcadores discursivos with more formulaic placement patrones. The method constructs a discourse marker profile and compares it against human reference distribucións using Jensen-Shannon divergence.
accuracy: Moderada - 73-83% precisión a través de domains
source: Kumarage et al. (2023) - Stylometric Detection of AI-Generated Text in Twitter Timelines, arXiv
algorithm: Discourse Marker Extraction + Positional Analysis + Distribution Comparison
parameters: Marker lexicon: 150+ markers, Position tracking: sentence-initial/medial/final, Frequency normalization: per-sentence, Comparison: JSD metric
strengths:
• Captures high-level text organization patrones
• Robust a través de different text lengths
• Linguistically interpretable características
• Complements token-level detección methods
limitations:
• Marker inventory varies a través de languages
• Genre-dependent baseline distribucións
• Advanced LLMs can produce varied discourse patrones
• Requires careful marker taxonomy definition

references.title: Kumarage, T. et al. (2023). Stylometric Detection of AI-Generated Text in Twitter Timelines. arXiv.
Halliday, M. A. K. & Hasan, R. (1976). Cohesion in English. Longman.
Zellers, R. et al. (2019). Defending Against Neural Fake News. NeurIPS.
